verdict: Maybe. Winston from Faridabad pitched tech beauty devices for home use on Shark Tank India Season 2 and got a deal. Devices like hair removers and facial tools sell well online, but electronics need strong quality control and after-sales service.
angle: Buyers want salon results at home. Devices are often sourced from contract manufacturers, so your edge is quality control, design and service. Warranty claims and returns can be costly if quality slips.
